newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha extends losses little support seen.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha extends losses little support seen.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices extended Friday's sharp losses by around a further $4-5 with some heavy trade selling reported on the swaps market on Monday.
Traders said firmer crude futures were the only supportive factor in early business but weak prompt fundamentals again came into play as crude gave up its early gains.
Ample supply in NWE saw trade houses pressuring the swaps market again today.
Traders said the trade houses were looking to capitalise on equities in the Mediterranean.
March swaps were reported traded down to $187 a tonne.
There was was active Eurograde gasoline/naphtha spread trade at around $10.50.
April swaps were in contango by around $2-3 a tonne compared with a backwardation early last week of $3-$4.
NWE cargoes talked notionally around $187/$191 cif.
